source.citation: Wenner et al. 2025, Global Ecology and Conservation, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gecco.2025.e03837

evidence.original_field_protocol: Paper Methods describe 15-50 bottle traps per site, two nights; physical trap identities per native row not verified.

claim_boundary: surv identifies a composite site-method-day grouping key; it is not a proven physical unique visit or trap ID.
Group-key repetition alone does not prove data entry errors; two recorded species-count vectors differ within those groups.
Separate physical trap observations, corrections and source inconsistencies cannot be distinguished without field logs.
Do not deduplicate without a source-supported physical sampling-unit rule.
Existing rowwise occupancy STOP is conditional on an unsupported unique survey-key assumption, not a published ecological refutation.
Do not reopen three locked EOG-WF endpoints or claim ecological A/B/M, occupancy or causal effects.
